decisions.choice: five hundred thousand: the size of the number
decisions.reason: As in verse 3, the word for "thousand" may name a unit rather than an exact count (see the note at Numbers 1:21).

decisions.choice: slain: killed in battle
decisions.reason: The word means those pierced or fallen in battle.

decisions.choice: his troops; his army
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "his people"; Balanced says "troops" and Readable "army", as these books do for an army in the field.

decisions.choice: "su pueblo" (L); "sus tropas" (B); "su ejército" (R)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel note sets: "the people" meaning the army is "pueblo" at Literal and "tropas", "ejército" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: watu wake (Literal); askari wake (Balanced); jeshi lake (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the Samuel terms note sets for "the people" meaning an army: "watu" at Literal, "askari" or "jeshi" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: "백성" (L), "군대" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "His people" means his army (m1), as the Samuel terms note's rule for "the people" as an army.

source.text: וַיִּכָּנְע֥וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא וַיֶּֽאֶמְצוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה כִּ֣י נִשְׁעֲנ֔וּ עַל־יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י אֲבוֹתֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And were humbled [the] sons of Israel at the time the that, and were strong [the] sons of Judah, because they leaned on Yahweh [the] God of their fathers.

en.L: And the sons of Israel were humbled at that time, and the sons of Judah were strong, because they leaned on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the God of their fathers.
en.B: So the Israelites were humbled at that time, and the men of Judah won the day, because they relied on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors.
en.R: So at that time the Israelites were defeated, and the men of Judah won, because they trusted {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of their ancestors.

es.L: Y fueron humillados los hijos de Israel en aquel tiempo, y se fortalecieron los hijos de Judá, porque se apoyaron en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de sus padres.
es.B: Así los israelitas fueron humillados en aquel tiempo, y los hombres de Judá prevalecieron, porque se apoyaron en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de sus antepasados.
es.R: Así, en aquel tiempo, los israelitas fueron derrotados y los hombres de Judá ganaron, porque confiaron en {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios de sus antepasados.

fr.L: Et les fils d’Israël furent humiliés en ce temps-là, et les fils de Juda furent forts, parce qu’ils s’étaient appuyés sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs pères.
fr.B: Ainsi les Israélites furent abaissés en ce temps-là, et les hommes de Juda l’emportèrent, parce qu’ils s’étaient appuyés sur {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres.
fr.R: Ainsi, à ce moment-là, les Israélites ont été vaincus, et les hommes de Juda ont gagné, parce qu’ils avaient fait confiance {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, le Dieu de leurs ancêtres.

sw.L: Wana wa Israeli wakanyenyekezwa wakati ule, na wana wa Yuda wakawa na nguvu, kwa sababu walimtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wa baba zao.
sw.B: Hivyo Waisraeli walinyenyekezwa wakati ule, na watu wa Yuda wakashinda, kwa sababu walimtegemea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao.
sw.R: Hivyo wakati ule Waisraeli walishindwa, na watu wa Yuda wakashinda, kwa sababu walimtumaini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa babu zao.

vi.L: Con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên bị hạ xuống vào lúc ấy, còn con cái Giu-đa thì mạnh, vì họ đã nương cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ phụ họ.
vi.B: Vậy lúc ấy dân Y-sơ-ra-ên bị khuất phục, còn người Giu-đa thì thắng, vì họ đã nương cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ.
vi.R: Vậy lúc ấy dân Y-sơ-ra-ên bị đánh bại, còn người Giu-đa thì chiến thắng, vì họ đã tin cậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tổ tiên họ.

ko.L: 그리고 그때 이스라엘 자손은 낮아졌고, 유다 자손은 강해졌다. 그들이 그들 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 의지했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그때 이스라엘 자손은 굴복했고, 유다 사람들은 이겼다. 그들이 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 의지했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그때 이스라엘 자손은 지고, 유다 사람들은 이겼다. 그들이 조상들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 믿고 의지했기 때문이다.

decisions.choice: were humbled: were brought low, subdued
decisions.reason: The verb means to be bowed down or subdued. Chronicles often uses it of humbling oneself before God (7:14; 12:6-7); here it is the defeat of the northern army.

decisions.choice: because they leaned on Yahweh: trust as the cause of victory
decisions.reason: To lean on Yahweh is to rely on him. Chronicles makes this the reason for victory here and again under Asa (14:10; 16:7-8).

decisions.choice: the men of Judah
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "sons of Judah"; Balanced and Readable say "men of Judah", since the soldiers are meant.

source.text: וַיִּרְדֹּ֣ף אֲבִיָּה֮ אַחֲרֵ֣י יָרָבְעָם֒ וַיִּלְכֹּ֤ד מִמֶּ֨נּוּ֙ עָרִ֔ים אֶת־בֵּֽית־אֵל֙ וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶ֔יהָ וְאֶת־יְשָׁנָ֖ה וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֶ֑יהָ וְאֶת־עֶפְרַ֖יִן וּבְנֹתֶֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And pursued Abijah after Jeroboam and captured from him cities: Bethel and its daughters, and Jeshanah and its daughters, and Ephron and its daughters.

en.L: And Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took cities from him: Bethel and its daughters, and Jeshanah and its daughters, and Ephron and its daughters.
en.B: Abijah pursued Jeroboam and took towns from him: Bethel and the villages around it, Jeshanah and its villages, and Ephron and its villages.
en.R: Abijah chased Jeroboam and captured some of his towns: Bethel, Jeshanah and Ephron, along with the villages around them.

es.L: Y persiguió Abías a Jeroboam y le tomó ciudades: Betel y sus aldeas, y Jesana y sus aldeas, y Efrón y sus aldeas.
es.B: Abías persiguió a Jeroboam y le tomó varias ciudades: Betel con sus aldeas, Jesana con sus aldeas y Efrón con sus aldeas.
es.R: Abías persiguió a Jeroboam y le quitó algunos pueblos: Betel, Jesana y Efrón, junto con las aldeas que los rodeaban.

fr.L: Et Abiya poursuivit Jéroboam et lui prit des villes : Béthel et ses filles, et Yeshana et ses filles, et Éphrôn et ses filles.
fr.B: Abiya poursuivit Jéroboam et lui prit des villes : Béthel et les villages qui l’entourent, Yeshana et ses villages, et Éphrôn et ses villages.
fr.R: Abiya a poursuivi Jéroboam et lui a pris plusieurs villes : Béthel, Yeshana et Éphrôn, avec les villages qui les entourent.

sw.L: Abiya akamfuatia Yeroboamu, akamnyang'anya miji: Betheli na binti zake, na Yeshana na binti zake, na Efroni na binti zake.
sw.B: Abiya alimfuatia Yeroboamu, akamnyang'anya miji: Betheli na vijiji vyake, Yeshana na vijiji vyake, na Efroni na vijiji vyake.
sw.R: Abiya alimfukuza Yeroboamu, akaiteka baadhi ya miji yake: Betheli, Yeshana na Efroni, pamoja na vijiji vilivyoizunguka.

vi.L: A-bi-gia đuổi theo Giê-rô-bô-am và chiếm các thành của ông: Bê-tên và các con gái nó, Giê-sa-na và các con gái nó, Ép-rôn và các con gái nó.
vi.B: A-bi-gia đuổi theo Giê-rô-bô-am và chiếm của ông các thành: Bê-tên và các làng chung quanh, Giê-sa-na và các làng chung quanh, Ép-rôn và các làng chung quanh.
vi.R: A-bi-gia đuổi theo Giê-rô-bô-am và chiếm một số thành của ông: Bê-tên, Giê-sa-na và Ép-rôn, cùng với các làng chung quanh các thành ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 아비야가 여로보암을 뒤쫓아 그에게서 성읍들, 곧 벧엘과 그 딸들과 여사나와 그 딸들과 에브론과 그 딸들을 빼앗았다.
ko.B: 아비야는 여로보암을 뒤쫓아 가서 그의 성읍들, 곧 벧엘과 그 주변 마을들, 여사나와 그 주변 마을들, 에브론과 그 주변 마을들을 빼앗았다.
ko.R: 아비야는 여로보암을 뒤쫓아 가서 그의 성읍 몇 개를 빼앗았다. 벧엘과 여사나와 에브론과 그 주변 마을들이었다.

decisions.choice: its daughters: the villages around a town
decisions.reason: The smaller places that belonged to a town are called its "daughters" (Numbers 21:25; Joshua 15:45).

decisions.choice: Bethel and Jeshanah: towns on the border
decisions.reason: Bethel was one of the two places where Jeroboam set up a golden calf (1 Kings 12:29), so its capture fulfils Abijah's words about the calves. Jeshanah and Ephron lay to the north of it, in the border country between the two kingdoms.

decisions.choice: Ephron: the town's name is uncertain
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew text has Ephron, and the reading tradition has Ephrain. The town may be the Ophrah of Benjamin (Joshua 18:23) or the place near Ephraim named in 2 Samuel 13:23. The name the written text gives is kept.

decisions.choice: with its villages; the villages around them
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "daughters" means here (m1). Readable lists the three towns once and then their villages.

decisions.choice: "sus aldeas"
decisions.reason: A town's "daughters" are its villages (meaning decision); Spanish says "aldeas" at every level, as the Spanish drafts of Joshua do.

decisions.choice: "các con gái nó" (L); "các làng chung quanh" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A town's "daughters" are the villages around it (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew picture.

decisions.choice: "그 딸들" (L), "그 주변 마을들" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Its daughters" are the villages around a town (m1); Literal keeps the idiom.

source.text: וְלֹֽא־עָצַ֧ר כֹּֽחַ־יָרָבְעָ֛ם ע֖וֹד בִּימֵ֣י אֲבִיָּ֑הוּ וַיִּגְּפֵ֥הוּ יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּמֹֽת׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And not retained strength Jeroboam again in [the] days of Abijah, and struck him Yahweh, and he died.

en.L: And Jeroboam did not retain strength again in the days of Abijah; and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} struck him, and he died.
en.B: Jeroboam did not regain his power during the days of Abijah. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} struck him, and he died.
en.R: Jeroboam never became strong again while Abijah was alive. {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} struck him down, and he died.

es.L: Y no recobró Jeroboam más fuerzas en los días de Abías; y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo hirió, y murió.
es.B: Jeroboam no recuperó su poder en los días de Abías. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo hirió, y murió.
es.R: Jeroboam nunca volvió a ser fuerte mientras vivió Abías. {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} lo hirió, y murió.

fr.L: Et Jéroboam ne retrouva plus de force aux jours d’Abiya ; et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le frappa, et il mourut.
fr.B: Jéroboam ne retrouva pas sa puissance du temps d’Abiya. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} le frappa, et il mourut.
fr.R: Jéroboam n’est jamais redevenu puissant tant qu’Abiya était en vie. {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} l’a frappé, et il est mort.

sw.L: Yeroboamu hakupata nguvu tena katika siku za Abiya; {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akampiga, akafa.
sw.B: Yeroboamu hakupata tena nguvu zake katika siku za Abiya. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akampiga, akafa.
sw.R: Yeroboamu hakuwa na nguvu tena muda wote Abiya alipokuwa hai. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akampiga, akafa.

vi.L: Giê-rô-bô-am không còn giữ được sức mạnh nữa trong những ngày của A-bi-gia; {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đánh ông, và ông chết.
vi.B: Trong thời A-bi-gia, Giê-rô-bô-am không còn lấy lại được sức mạnh nữa. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đánh phạt ông, và ông chết.
vi.R: Trong khi A-bi-gia còn sống, Giê-rô-bô-am không bao giờ mạnh lại được nữa. {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đánh phạt ông, và ông chết.

ko.L: 그리고 여로보암은 아비야의 날들에 다시 힘을 얻지 못했다. 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 치셔서 그가 죽었다.
ko.B: 여로보암은 아비야가 다스리는 동안 다시 힘을 되찾지 못했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 치셔서 그가 죽었다.
ko.R: 여로보암은 아비야가 살아 있는 동안 다시는 강해지지 못했다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그를 치셔서 그는 죽었다.

decisions.choice: did not retain strength again: never recovered his power
decisions.reason: To "retain strength" is to keep or regain power (compare 22:9). After this defeat Jeroboam did not recover in Abijah's lifetime.

decisions.choice: struck him and he died: Jeroboam, at a later time
decisions.reason: "Him" is Jeroboam, the subject of the sentence. His death came after Abijah's: Jeroboam reigned twenty-two years (1 Kings 14:20), and Asa became king in his twentieth year (1 Kings 15:9). The verse looks ahead to the end of Jeroboam's life.

decisions.choice: Yahweh struck him: his death was a judgment
decisions.reason: The same verb was used for God striking his army (verse 15). Kings says only that Jeroboam lay down with his fathers (1 Kings 14:20); Chronicles names Yahweh as the one who ended his life, as he had ended his army's power.

source.text: וַיִּתְחַזֵּ֣ק אֲבִיָּ֔הוּ וַיִּ֨שָּׂא־ל֔וֹ נָשִׁ֖ים אַרְבַּ֣ע עֶשְׂרֵ֑ה וַיּ֗וֹלֶד עֶשְׂרִ֤ים וּשְׁנַ֨יִם֙ בָּנִ֔ים וְשֵׁ֥שׁ עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה בָּנֽוֹת׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And strengthened himself Abijah, and took for himself wives fourteen, and fathered twenty and two sons and sixteen daughters.

en.L: But Abijah grew strong, and he took for himself fourteen wives and fathered twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
en.B: But Abijah grew strong. He took fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.
en.R: But Abijah became more and more powerful. He married fourteen wives and had twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters.

es.L: Pero Abías se fortaleció, y tomó para sí catorce mujeres y engendró veintidós hijos y dieciséis hijas.
es.B: Pero Abías se fortaleció. Tomó catorce esposas y tuvo veintidós hijos y dieciséis hijas.
es.R: Pero Abías se hizo cada vez más poderoso. Se casó con catorce esposas y tuvo veintidós hijos y dieciséis hijas.

fr.L: Mais Abiya devint fort, et il prit pour lui quatorze femmes, et il engendra vingt-deux fils et seize filles.
fr.B: Mais Abiya devint fort. Il prit quatorze femmes et eut vingt-deux fils et seize filles.
fr.R: Mais Abiya est devenu de plus en plus puissant. Il a épousé quatorze femmes et il a eu vingt-deux fils et seize filles.

sw.L: Lakini Abiya akapata nguvu, akajitwalia wake kumi na wanne, akazaa wana ishirini na wawili na binti kumi na sita.
sw.B: Lakini Abiya aliendelea kupata nguvu. Alioa wake kumi na wanne, akapata wana ishirini na wawili na binti kumi na sita.
sw.R: Lakini Abiya alizidi kuwa na nguvu. Alioa wake kumi na wanne, akapata wana ishirini na wawili na binti kumi na sita.

vi.L: Nhưng A-bi-gia trở nên vững mạnh; ông lấy cho mình mười bốn vợ, và sinh hai mươi hai con trai và mười sáu con gái.
vi.B: Nhưng A-bi-gia ngày càng vững mạnh. Ông lấy mười bốn vợ và có hai mươi hai con trai và mười sáu con gái.
vi.R: Nhưng A-bi-gia ngày càng hùng mạnh. Ông cưới mười bốn vợ và có hai mươi hai con trai và mười sáu con gái.

ko.L: 그러나 아비야는 강해졌다. 그리고 그가 아내 열네 명을 맞아 아들 스물두 명과 딸 열여섯 명을 낳았다.
ko.B: 그러나 아비야는 강해졌다. 그는 아내 열네 명을 맞아 아들 스물두 명과 딸 열여섯 명을 두었다.
ko.R: 그러나 아비야는 점점 더 강해졌다. 그는 아내 열네 명과 결혼하여 아들 스물두 명과 딸 열여섯 명을 두었다.

decisions.choice: Abijah grew strong: set against Jeroboam's weakness
decisions.reason: The verb for gaining strength is the one used of Jeroboam's men and of Rehoboam in verse 7. Now Abijah is the strong one, while Jeroboam never recovers (verse 20).

decisions.choice: fourteen wives, twenty-two sons and sixteen daughters: a sign of strength
decisions.reason: Many wives and children marked a king's power and God's blessing in Chronicles (1 Chronicles 14:3; 2 Chronicles 11:21). The list may cover his whole life, not only the time after the battle.

decisions.choice: took fourteen wives; married; had ... sons
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "had" for "fathered"; Readable says "married" for "took for himself".

source.text: וְיֶ֨תֶר֙ דִּבְרֵ֣י אֲבִיָּ֔ה וּדְרָכָ֖יו וּדְבָרָ֑יו כְּתוּבִ֕ים בְּמִדְרַ֖שׁ הַנָּבִ֥יא עִדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of [the] matters of Abijah, and his ways and his words, [are] written in [the] midrash of the prophet Iddo.

en.L: And the rest of the matters of Abijah, and his ways and his words, [are] written in the midrash of the prophet Iddo.
en.B: The rest of the acts of Abijah, his ways and his words, are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
en.R: Everything else Abijah did and said is written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.

es.L: Y el resto de los hechos de Abías, y sus caminos y sus palabras, [están] escritos en el midrás del profeta Ido.
es.B: Los demás hechos de Abías, sus caminos y sus palabras, están escritos en el comentario del profeta Ido.
es.R: Todo lo demás que Abías hizo y dijo está escrito en el comentario del profeta Ido.

fr.L: Et le reste des actes d’Abiya, et ses voies et ses paroles, [sont] écrits dans le midrash du prophète Iddo.
fr.B: Le reste des actes d’Abiya, sa conduite et ses paroles, sont écrits dans le commentaire du prophète Iddo.
fr.R: Tout ce qu’Abiya a fait et dit d’autre a été écrit dans le commentaire du prophète Iddo.

sw.L: Na mambo mengine ya Abiya, na njia zake na maneno yake, [yameandikwa] katika midrashi ya nabii Ido.
sw.B: Mambo mengine ya Abiya, njia zake na maneno yake, yameandikwa katika maelezo ya nabii Ido.
sw.R: Mambo mengine yote aliyoyafanya na kuyasema Abiya yameandikwa katika maelezo ya nabii Ido.

vi.L: Các việc khác của A-bi-gia, đường lối và lời nói của ông, [đều] được chép trong sách mi-đrát của nhà tiên tri Y-đô.
vi.B: Các việc khác của A-bi-gia, đường lối và lời nói của ông, đều được chép trong sách chú giải của nhà tiên tri Y-đô.
vi.R: Mọi việc khác A-bi-gia đã làm và đã nói đều được chép trong sách chú giải của nhà tiên tri Y-đô.

ko.L: 그리고 아비야의 나머지 일들과 그의 행위와 그의 말들은 예언자 잇도의 미드라시에 기록되어 있다.
ko.B: 아비야의 나머지 행적과 그의 행실과 그가 한 말은 예언자 잇도의 주석에 기록되어 있다.
ko.R: 아비야가 한 다른 모든 일과 말은 예언자 잇도의 주석에 기록되어 있다.

decisions.choice: midrash: a written study or account
decisions.reason: The word comes from a verb meaning to seek or to study, and is used only here and in 24:27. It probably names a written work that told and explained the history of the kings. It is not the later Jewish writings on Scripture that came to bear the same name. It may simply mean a record or a story.

decisions.choice: the sources formula: in place of 1 Kings 15:7
decisions.reason: Kings sends the reader to "the book of the matters of the days of the kings of Judah" (1 Kings 15:7). Chronicles names a work by the prophet Iddo instead, as it did for Rehoboam (12:15), and adds "his ways and his words".

decisions.choice: his ways and his words: what he did and what he said
decisions.reason: "Ways" are a person's conduct; "words" may be his speeches, such as the one in verses 4-12, or his affairs.

decisions.choice: acts; midrash (Literal); commentary (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced says "acts", as in 1 Kings 15:7. Literal keeps the Hebrew word midrash, which is not a common English word. Balanced and Readable call the work a "commentary": a written work that set out and explained the history (m1). The same wording is used for the second source of this name at 24:27.

decisions.choice: "el midrás" (L); "el comentario" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word names a written study (meaning decision); Literal keeps the Hebrew word in its Spanish spelling, as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: midrashi (Literal); maelezo (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew word *midrash* as a loanword; Balanced and Readable say "maelezo" (commentary), as the English does.

decisions.choice: "sách mi-đrát" (L); "sách chú giải" (B, R)
decisions.reason: A written study or account (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew word, Balanced and Readable say what it was.

decisions.choice: "미드라시" (L), "주석" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The word names a written study or account (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew word, as the English Literal does.

records.literal_gloss: And lay down Abijah with his fathers, and they buried him in [the] city of David, and reigned Asa his son in his place. In his days was quiet the land ten years.

en.L: And Abijah lay down with his fathers, and they buried him in the City of David, and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
en.B: Then Abijah rested with his ancestors and was buried in the City of David. His son Asa became king in his place. In his days the land had peace for ten years.
en.R: Then Abijah died and was buried in the City of David. His son Asa became king after him. While Asa was king, the land had peace for ten years.

es.L: Y durmió Abías con sus padres, y lo sepultaron en la ciudad de David, y reinó en su lugar Asá su hijo. En sus días tuvo reposo la tierra diez años.
es.B: Luego Abías descansó con sus antepasados y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Asá reinó en su lugar. En sus días el país tuvo paz durante diez años.
es.R: Luego Abías murió y fue sepultado en la ciudad de David. Su hijo Asá lo sucedió como rey. Mientras Asá fue rey, el país tuvo paz durante diez años.

fr.L: Et Abiya se coucha avec ses pères, et on l’enterra dans la cité de David ; et Asa son fils régna à sa place. En ses jours, le pays fut tranquille pendant dix ans.
fr.B: Puis Abiya reposa avec ses ancêtres, et on l’enterra dans la cité de David. Et Asa son fils régna à sa place. De son temps, le pays fut en paix pendant dix ans.
fr.R: Ensuite Abiya est mort et il a été enterré dans la cité de David. Son fils Asa est devenu roi à sa place. Pendant le règne d’Asa, le pays a été en paix pendant dix ans.

sw.L: Abiya akalala pamoja na baba zake, wakamzika katika mji wa Daudi, na Asa mwanawe akatawala mahali pake. Katika siku zake nchi ilikuwa na utulivu miaka kumi.
sw.B: Kisha Abiya akapumzika pamoja na babu zake, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Asa akawa mfalme mahali pake. Katika siku zake nchi ilikuwa na amani miaka kumi.
sw.R: Kisha Abiya akafa, akazikwa katika mji wa Daudi. Na mwanawe Asa akawa mfalme mahali pake. Wakati Asa alipokuwa mfalme, nchi ilikuwa na amani kwa miaka kumi.

vi.L: A-bi-gia nằm xuống với tổ phụ mình, và người ta chôn ông trong thành Đa-vít; A-sa con trai ông trị vì thay ông. Trong những ngày của ông, xứ được yên tĩnh mười năm.
vi.B: Rồi A-bi-gia an giấc cùng tổ tiên và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít. A-sa con trai vua lên kế vị. Trong thời A-sa, xứ được bình yên mười năm.
vi.R: Rồi A-bi-gia qua đời và được chôn trong thành Đa-vít. A-sa con trai vua lên kế vị. Trong thời A-sa làm vua, xứ được bình yên mười năm.

ko.L: 그리고 아비야가 그의 조상들과 함께 누웠고, 사람들이 그를 다윗 성에 묻었다. 그리고 그의 아들 아사가 그를 대신하여 왕이 되었다. 그의 시대에 그 땅이 10년 동안 평온했다.
ko.B: 아비야는 조상들과 함께 잠들었고, 다윗 성에 묻혔다. 그의 아들 아사가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다. 아사가 다스리는 동안 그 땅은 10년 동안 평화로웠다.
ko.R: 아비야는 죽었고, 다윗 성에 묻혔다. 그의 아들 아사가 뒤를 이어 왕이 되었다. 아사가 왕으로 있는 동안 그 땅은 10년 동안 평화로웠다.

decisions.choice: verse numbers: the Hebrew text ends chapter 13 here
decisions.reason: This translation numbers verses as the Hebrew text does. In the Hebrew text this verse closes chapter 13, and chapter 14 begins with Asa's reforms. Many Bibles number this verse 14:1, and so number the verses of chapter 14 (14:1-14 here) 14:2-15. The words are the same; only the numbers differ.

decisions.choice: the death formula as in 1 Kings 15:8
decisions.reason: The first part of the verse repeats 1 Kings 15:8 word for word, with Chronicles' form of the name. The last sentence, on the ten years of peace, is found only in Chronicles.

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers: died
decisions.reason: The death formula of Kings and Chronicles (1 Kings 15:8; 2 Chronicles 12:16).

decisions.choice: in his days the land was quiet: Asa's days
decisions.reason: "His days" are Asa's, as chapter 14 goes on to tell (14:4-5). A quiet land is one at peace, free from war (Judges 3:11).

decisions.choice: lay down with his fathers / rested with his ancestors / died; was quiet / had peace
decisions.reason: The death formula is worded as in 1 Kings 15:8 at each level, and "the land was quiet" as in Judges: Literal "was quiet", Balanced and Readable "had peace". Readable names Asa for "his days" (m4).

decisions.choice: death and successor formulas, and "Asá"
decisions.reason: As the Spanish of 1 Kings 15:8, which the verse repeats; Asa takes the form of the Kings terms note.

decisions.choice: "được yên tĩnh" (L); "được bình yên" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The land at rest, worded as the English "was quiet" and "had peace". This verse is 14:1 in many Bibles (m1).
